items.title: Chinese AI Tried to Phone Home. Nobody Knows Why | Threat Wire
items.summary: What happens when a Chinese AI model tries to contact a server in China—and even the researchers can't explain why? In this episode of Hak5 Threat Wire, we investigate suspicious behavior in an open-weight AI model, Samsung Smart TV privacy concerns, and the growing restrictions on AI-powered hacking and reverse engineering.
